# Harper James Solicitors

> A modern commercial law firm providing affordable legal services to startups and growing businesses across corporate, finance, employment, and technology sectors.

Harper James Solicitors is a contemporary commercial law practice specializing in supporting businesses through their lifecycle stages. With pricing from £159/hour and expertise across 17+ practice areas including corporate law, banking & finance, employment law, and GDPR compliance, the firm serves entrepreneurs and scale-ups navigating complex legal challenges.

## Key Topics

- Commercial Law
- Corporate Law
- Banking and Finance
- Employment Law
- Data Protection & GDPR
- Business Immigration
- Intellectual Property
- Dispute Resolution
- Startup Support
- M&A and Funding Rounds
- Commercial Technology & IT Law
- Construction Law
- Insolvency & Corporate Recovery
- Employee Share Schemes
- Financial Services Regulation

## Core Services

- [Business Legal Services Overview](https://harperjames.co.uk/services): Complete overview of Harper James legal services covering commercial law, disputes, immigration, and business lifecycle support
- [Commercial Solicitors](https://harperjames.co.uk/services/commercial-solicitors): Commercial law services including contract drafting, negotiation, and affordable business legal advice
- [Corporate Solicitors](https://harperjames.co.uk/services/corporate-law): Corporate law services covering venture capital, M&A, share schemes, and business restructuring
- [Employment Solicitors](https://harperjames.co.uk/services/employment-law-solicitors): Employment law and HR support including tribunal defense and sickness management

## Finance & Property

- [Banking and Finance Solicitors](https://harperjames.co.uk/services/banking-and-finance): Banking and finance legal services for business lending, acquisition finance, and debt restructuring
- [Commercial Property Solicitors](https://harperjames.co.uk/services/commercial-property-solicitors): Commercial property law for transactions, leasing, buying, selling, and development
- [Financial Services Regulation](https://harperjames.co.uk/services/financial-services-regulation): Financial services regulation compliance with FCA and PRA authorization support
- [Insolvency & Corporate Recovery](https://harperjames.co.uk/services/insolvency-and-corporate-recovery): Insolvency and corporate recovery services for businesses facing financial difficulty

- [Commercial Technology Solicitors](https://harperjames.co.uk/services/commercial-technology-solicitors): Commercial technology and IT law including SaaS, software licensing, and cyber security
